# Truncation acknowledgments for .github/scripts/check_no_net_truncation.py
#
# One repo-relative path per line. A path listed here is exempt from the
# net-truncation tripwire: it declares that a large net deletion of that long
# governance doc is deliberate (a real split or removal), not an accidental
# partial-read-written-back truncation.
#
# Adding a path here is itself a reviewable signal — keep it minimal and remove
# entries once the deliberate shrink has merged.
#
# Deliberate split: Current authority map rows moved to docs/governance/authority/
# sub-indexes per AUTHORITY_INDEX_DECOMPOSITION_PLAN.md (PR D/E).
docs/governance/AUTHORITY_INDEX.md

# Deliberate consolidation: ROADMAP.md is reduced from an inventory-style
# document to current outcomes, blockers, exit criteria and next decisions.
# Detailed ownership and status remain in STATUS.md, WHAT_RUNS.md,
# AUTHORITY_INDEX.md and MODULES.md.
docs/governance/ROADMAP.md

# Deliberate reduction: installation composition material was removed after the
# human selected one common baseline. The catalog now owns only independent
# module records; the shared required component set lives in
# COMMON_INSTALLATION_BASELINE.md.
docs/governance/INSTALL_MODULE_CATALOG.md

# Deliberate doctrine replacement: the original Notion-owner/read-only proposal
# was replaced after the human selected PostgreSQL as the native Agency Data
# system of record, with Notion retained as an optional selectively editable
# collaborative projection. The generic ownership rule now lives in
# AGENCY_DATA_SYSTEM_OF_RECORD.md.
docs/governance/NOTION_AGENCY_DATA_BINDING.md

# Deliberate convergence: KNOWLEDGE_NAVIGATION_UX.md was reduced after its
# parallel knowledge_folder backend concept was absorbed by Category /
# CategoryAssignment. Source, production and progress lifecycle duplication now
# points to the existing owner documents; the retained file owns UX only.
docs/governance/KNOWLEDGE_NAVIGATION_UX.md

# Deliberate convergence: COCKPIT_CAPABILITY_MANAGEMENT.md now owns only the
# Cockpit projection/action boundary. Capability identity, binding, activation,
# compatibility and task/run legitimacy remain with their existing canonical
# owners instead of being repeated here.
docs/governance/COCKPIT_CAPABILITY_MANAGEMENT.md

# Deliberate convergence: COMPETENCE_MODEL.md now owns only the composition
# boundary between a governed reusable ability, professional content/support
# material and replaceable execution means. Vocabulary, capability activation,
# task authorization, Evidence, cards and persistence remain with existing owners.
docs/governance/COMPETENCE_MODEL.md

# Deliberate convergence: PANTHEON_COCKPIT_STRUCTURED_AGENCY_INTERFACE.md now
# owns product composition only. Detailed lifecycle, capability, Agency Data,
# Document and object schemas remain with their existing owners; root topology
# is aligned to the executable Navigation Registry instead of an aspirational list.
docs/governance/PANTHEON_COCKPIT_STRUCTURED_AGENCY_INTERFACE.md

# Deliberate convergence: CARD_STACK_MODEL.md now owns only generic Card / Scene /
# Deck / Constellation projection grammar. Product root topology, object-specific
# lifecycles and implementation ownership remain with their existing owners.
docs/governance/CARD_STACK_MODEL.md

# Deliberate selected-stack convergence: historic OpenWebUI/Paperless product
# ownership and repeated three-party topology are removed from central doctrine.
# Hermes clients own runtime interaction, Pantheon Cockpit owns governed
